description: This file defines the CampaignsParseRule class, which extends BaseRule and implements custom parsing logic for campaign panels in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system. It primarily modifies panel data during the 'preParse' phase for the 'EditView', such as adding a 'frequency' label or removing certain fields.

classes.name: CampaignsParseRule
classes.description: A custom rule class for parsing campaign panels in SuiteCRM, extending BaseRule, and overriding the preParse method to manipulate panel data before rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for CampaignsParseRule class; currently empty.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Modifies the panels array before rendering in the 'EditView'. Adds a 'frequency' label if empty, or removes the 'deleted' field.
